pass_meta.suite: Global Search V2 - V1 regression set
pass_meta.scope: the two phone cases, re-run after steps were added to them
pass_meta.how_judged: Both cases grew steps after the reconciliation, so their earlier results were about a smaller test. Re-run in full, and the number was then typed in four different layouts to find out which of them the search accepts.

C55662.observed: The company's whole phone number DOES find the customer, and in every layout tried - with brackets, with dashes, as bare digits and with spaces. Each returned the one customer. What fails is typing only PART of the number: the last seven characters return nothing at all, and neither do the last four. Since a person rarely has the whole number in front of them, that is the half people actually use.
C55662.todo: The report already raised for this needs its wording corrected before a developer picks it up - it currently says the customer cannot be found by its own telephone number, and today it can. The real fault is narrower: part of a number finds nothing.
C55662.technical: Whole number as (419) 555-0143, 419-555-0143, 4195550143 and 419 555 0143 -> Customers (1), the seeded customer, every time. Part of it as 555-0143 and 0143 -> Customers (0). Control: the same customer returns by name in the same sitting. This differs from the 14 September reading, which found the whole number failing too - either a fix has shipped since or that reading was wrong; today's is repeatable across four layouts.
C55662.ticket: Raised as SV-10057 - https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-10057 - which needs its wording corrected to the narrower fault.

C55670.observed: A contact's first name, a contact's surname and the contact's own whole phone number all find the company they work for - the number works with brackets and as bare digits alike. What fails is part of that number: the last seven characters return nothing.
C55670.todo: Nothing separate to raise - it is the same fault as the company's number, and the report for that one covers it once its wording is corrected.
C55670.technical: Marlene -> 11 customers including the seeded one; Okonkwo -> 1; (419) 555-0177 and 4195550177 -> Customers (1), the seeded customer; 555-0177 -> Customers (0). This case previously passed, but that was before the phone steps were added to it.
